project_type: Multi-stack boilerplate repository containing independent starters - building Beginner Static Astro site
build_system: pnpm (project-local, pinned packageManager field). Each starter is independent with its own manifest/lockfile.
test_framework: Vitest for unit tests + Playwright (via @playwright/test) for output tests + fast-check for property tests + @axe-core/playwright for accessibility
build_command: cd astro-beginner-static-site && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile 2. pnpm lint 3. pnpm check (astro check) 4. pnpm build 5. pnpm test:all (unit + output tests)
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory is generated but .gitignored - not checked in
environment_constraints: Internet access available. No external services needed for this Beginner Static starter - zero auth/database/payment/provider requirement.
contribution_requirements: Each starter must be fully standalone. No imports from root or other starters. Project-local pnpm manifest with exact-pinned direct dependencies. starter.json must match catalog entry. Beginner Static family: zero external services, dependency allowlist (only framework/styling/SEO/sitemap/static-output deps allowed as runtime).
key_patterns: Reference astro-adsense-blog pattern: astro.config.mjs with output:'static', eslint.config.mjs with eslint/typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin-astro, vitest.config.ts, tsconfig extending astro/tsconfigs/strict, .gitignore for node_modules/dist/.astro/.env, tests/output/ for Playwright-based built-output checks, tests/unit/ for vitest unit tests. Beginner static uses plain CSS (no Tailwind), no MDX, no content collections, no AdSense/analytics/consent.
directory_structure: Repository root has: catalog/ (starters.json + schema), scripts/ (validate-catalog.mjs), package.json (root validator only), 52 starter folders (direct children). Each starter has: src/ (pages, layouts, components, lib), tests/ (unit/, output/), package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, starter.json, README.md, config files.
